source_evidence: But a mutual fund or ETF won’t necessarily provide diversification, especially if it is narrowly focused (such as on one industry sector).
question: Misconception: Owning any mutual fund or ETF automatically makes your investments well diversified.
answer: A mutual fund or ETF does not necessarily provide diversification, especially if it focuses narrowly on one industry sector. Check the funds’ top holdings to see whether they differ and provide the diversification you’re seeking.
